caption:
Failed Class 6. Left school to work the coffee plantations. Built a company worth thousands of crores anyway.

P.C. Mustafa grew up in Chennalode, a remote Wayanad village with no roads or electricity, where his family survived on roughly 10 rupees a day. He failed Class 6 and dropped out to work alongside his father on the coffee plantations - until a teacher who spotted him in the fields personally convinced his parents to send him back to school. He went on to study engineering and in 2005 pooled 25,000 rupees in savings with five cousins to start iD Fresh Food, selling idli and dosa batter door to door. It took nine months just to reach 100 packets a day. iD Fresh Food is now valued in the thousands of crores.
